subject: Credit request after service impact - Clearsky AI
body:
From: Alex Harris <alex.harris@clearsky.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai; rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service impact 02/18 — request for credit and incident report

Hi Markus / Rachel,

We experienced a significant latency regression this morning between ~01:20 - 04:15 UTC (roughly 3 hours) where ~30% of our calls hit 5–10s tail latency and roughly 8% returned 502/504 errors. This broke our ingestion pipeline and caused a cascade of retries that impacted downstream users.

We need two things:
- A formal incident report with root cause, timeline, and remediation plan.
- Compensation for the incident (credits) applied to our account while you investigate — the hit was material for us this billing cycle.

We rely on Redwood’s latency SLOs, and this outage disrupted an A/B test and a revenue-facing job. Please advise the next steps and estimated credit amount. I can share logs if it helps.

Thanks,
Alex Harris
Head of ML Platform
Clearsky AI
alex.harris@clearsky.ai

-----Original Message Sent-----

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: alex.harris@clearsky.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact 02/18 — request for credit and incident report

Hi Alex — sorry to hear that hit you. We’re on it. I’ve looped in Sergio from Support to triage and produce an incident report; I’ll also coordinate a credit calculation with finance. Could you drop any logs or flight IDs (request ids) you have into the thread or share a Drive link?

Planned immediate steps:
- Sergio will investigate root cause and upload a preliminary incident report.
- We’ll run the SLA credit calc and propose a reimbursement (account credit) or invoice adjustment.
- We’ll propose a customer-facing remediation and mitigation plan.

Appreciate the flag — we’ll move fast.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message Sent-----

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai; alex.harris@clearsky.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact 02/18 — request for credit and incident report

Alex / Rachel — I dug into the telemetry and attached a preliminary incident report (incident_report_Clearsky_20260218.pdf) plus a short SLA calculation (SLA_credit_calculation.xlsx). TL;DR: a mis-deployed kernel selection rule caused an inefficient execution path on a shard serving Clearsky traffic; that led to memory pressure and increased tail latency. A traffic shift and autoscaler reaction created a spike of 502 errors for a subset of the fleet.

Root cause summary:
- 01:12 UTC: config push rolled out (kernel selector delta).
- 01:20–04:15 UTC: elevated queue time and backpressure on shard A; tail latencies 3–10s; error rates peaked ~8%.
- 04:17 UTC: rollback initiated; 04:25 UTC: metrics converged toward baseline.

Proposed remediation:
- We’ve pinned your production model to the pre-change kernel selection until we finish expanded validation.
- We'll add an additional health-check gate to block risky rollout on low-util shards.

Credit proposal (preliminary):
- Using our SLA formula in the attached spreadsheet, we calculate an eligible credit of the greater of: 5% of Clearsky’s monthly spend or $12,000 for the impacted window. We can apply as a credit to the next invoice or a direct invoice adjustment.

Please confirm whether Clearsky prefers an account credit or an invoice correction and if we should push for an immediate partial credit while we finalize the full report.

Attachments: incident_report_Clearsky_20260218.pdf (stated), SLA_credit_calculation.xlsx (stated)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message Sent-----

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai; rachel_kim@redwood.ai; sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Service impact 02/18 — credit proposal for Clearsky (CLEAR-1472)

Vanessa — looping you in for approval on the proposed credit. Clearsky is asking for compensation due to the latency regression; Sergio calculated eligible credit at min(5% monthly spend, $12,000). Clearsky’s monthly ARR usage this season averages about $240k, so 5% aligns to $12k exactly.

Ask: approve issuing a $12,000 account credit applied to their next invoice, and signoff on a 14-day trial extension for any sandbox usage they lost while we remediate. Finance will need a credit memo and an accounting tag; legal has no redlines here.

Notes: deal id CLEAR-1472, region: us. I’ve attached the incident report and SLA calc.

-Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

-----Original Message Sent-----

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai; rachel_kim@redwood.ai; sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Service impact 02/18 — credit proposal for Clearsky (CLEAR-1472)

Thanks Markus. I reviewed the incident packet and the SLA calc. Finance approves a one-time account credit of $12,000 applied to the next billed invoice. A couple of implementation requests:
- Please use the attached credit_memo_template.docx and set the accounting tag to: AR-CREDIT-CLEAR-1472.
- Cap: we need to confirm this is a one-off and document in the customer record; do not recommend recurring credits.
- If the customer prefers an invoice adjustment (rather than applied credit), we’ll need PO/invoice number to post the adjustment.

Rachel — can you confirm the customer preference for application and get DocuSign if they want a formal addendum? I’ll queue the credit for next billing run once we have the memo filled.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message Sent-----

From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: alex.harris@clearsky.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai; sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Resolution: $12,000 account credit + 14-day sandbox extension (Clearsky)

Hi Alex — thanks for your patience. Per the incident review and finance approval, Redwood will:

1) Apply a one-time $12,000 credit to Clearsky’s next invoice (accounting tag AR-CREDIT-CLEAR-1472).
2) Apply a 14-day extension to your sandbox/test environment so you have time to re-run the impacted A/B tests.
3) Incident report attached (finalized) and follow-up remediation plan summarized below.

Follow-up actions for Clearsky:
- Confirm whether you prefer the credit as an invoice adjustment (need invoice/PO) or as an account credit applied automatically.
- Confirm an owner for the sandbox extension (we can schedule a short handoff with our Product Ops).

We’ve attached the final incident_report_Clearsky_20260218.pdf and the SLA calculation that was used to derive the credit. Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-clearsky-incident-report

Thanks again for flagging this — we’ll continue to rollout the extra validation gates to avoid recurrence.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: incident_report_Clearsky_20260218.pdf, SLA_credit_calculation.xlsx
